title: LHON Registry for Treatment-Naïve LHON Patients & LHON Patients on Treatment
summary:
Despite progress in the treatment of LHON, general awareness of the disease and data on its course, spread and long-term outcomes are limited. 
This registry study therefore attempts to collect data on the course of LHON patients, long-term monitoring of treatment and clinical outcomes.
No drug is being tested in this registry study.
conditions: Other disorders of optic [2nd] nerve and visual pathways

interventions.name:
Register study
Retrospective and prospective health data capture of LHON patients

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Patients diagnosed with LHON by clinical and/or genetic diagnosis (i.e. carriers of at least one pathogenic mutation known or suspected to cause LHON)

• Willing to provide patient authorization/informed consent for the use of their pseudonymized data

• Patients between 14 and 18 years of age can only participate if their legal guardians grant authorization/informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
There are no exclusion criteria.
